om1omg02.dialogue: Hulu, your weapons, put them down! I not seek harm, no harm for you.
om1omg02.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg04.dialogue: Hai, hai, you are brave! You talk to me, I am a lost one, that is bad grebbo! Very bad grebbo, to talk with one who has lost his clan.
om1omg04.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg05.dialogue: Hoy, hep, no no, do not talk about grebbo! Very bad grebbo, very very bad grebbo, to talk about grebbo.
om1omg05.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg06.dialogue: Hozo! So you are touched ones, lucky you, touched ones not care about grebbo.
om1omg06.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg07.dialogue: I am glad, very glad, for we are cast, cast out of tribe, and I am lost, lost, I seek my clan, the Sharpstick clan, have you seen them?
om1omg07.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg08.dialogue: I sought the magic thing, fool, foolish, an ormyrr seeking the magic thing.
om1omg08.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg09.dialogue: Now we are cast, cast out, cast out of tribe, and I am lost, lost, I seek my clan, the Sharpstick clan, have you seen them?
om1omg09.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg10.dialogue: Touched, touched, lucky, yes, no worry about grebbo for touched ones.
om1omg10.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg12.dialogue: Hoi, hep, that is bad, bad, I cannot find them.
om1omg12.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg13.dialogue: I sought the thing, the magic thing, fool, foolish, an ormyrr seeking the magic thing. And so I lost my clan.
om1omg13.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg14.dialogue: I have grebbo, very bad grebbo, but you are touched, touched stronger than grebbo, eh eh?
om1omg14.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg16.dialogue: Yes, yes, lost, I sought the magic thing, fool, foolish, an ormyrr seeking the magic thing.
om1omg16.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg18.dialogue: Yes, yes, we talk on another thing.
om1omg18.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg20.dialogue: Lizards, yes, and big-orc, yes yes, and orc-orc, everyone seeks the magic thing.
om1omg20.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg22.dialogue: Yes, room below, many orc-orcs, orcs bad grebbo for Ormyrrs, very bad, I not go near.
om1omg22.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg26.dialogue: First, we were cast out, my clan, Sharpsticks, cast out. Sharpsticks all cast out from our tribe, the Marshdown tribe.
om1omg26.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg27.dialogue: Then I leave my clan, I wander alone, I seek the magic thing, if we find the magic, we go back to tribe, the Marshdown tribe.
om1omg27.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg28.dialogue: But I no find the magic thing, I only find the magic twig. And I lose, lose, lose my clan, I am lost, lost, I am a lost one, I seek the Sharpstick clan.
om1omg28.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg29.dialogue: Ah, hulu, so they are up, up, they look for me, they forgive, forgive me for seeking magic thing!
om1omg29.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg30.dialogue: I must go, go soon, go to find my clan, this is good, good, very good.
om1omg30.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg31.dialogue: Hoopa, I tell you, tell you story, story of Ormyrrs and the magic thing.
om1omg31.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg32.dialogue: In beginning, in beginning time, White Lady give out magic things, things for all people in Faerun.
om1omg32.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg33.dialogue: Humans get nice thing, elves get nice thing, dragons get big nice thing, things, magic things for every people, the Lady gives out things.
om1omg33.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg34.dialogue: But the Ormyrrs are not watching, Ormyrrs shaking drums and making spears, Ormyrrs not take thing, no thing, Lady drop thing in mud, thing is lost, lost, lost thing.
om1omg34.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg35.dialogue: So no magic for Ormyrrs, not ever, none, no magic until they find the magic thing.
om1omg35.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg37.dialogue: No, no, never, no spells for Ormyrr, until they find the magic thing.
om1omg37.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg39.dialogue: Nobody knows, nobody ever finds, never, maybe is no magic thing.
om1omg39.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg42.dialogue: You are good, good to me, not raise weapon, not seek harm.
om1omg42.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg43.dialogue: You are good, good to me, tell me this, not seek harm.
om1omg43.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg44.dialogue: You are good, good to me, hear my story, not seek harm.
om1omg44.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg45.dialogue: Ah, you are good, you not seek harm, you help Ormyrrs.
om1omg45.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg46.dialogue: Oi, oi, so my clan says, so says the one called Nottle, says no magic thing, myth, story, no magic thing.
om1omg46.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg47.dialogue: Maybe you are right, you are touched ones, you stronger than twig.
om1omg47.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg48.dialogue: Ah, this you say, like man in rock say, man in rock nearby, you give hope, you touched ones.
om1omg48.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg49.dialogue: Ah, good, this is good, maybe orcs have it, orcs below, orcs scare Ormyrrs, orcs bad grebbo, we no fight orcs below.
om1omg49.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg52.dialogue: Here, I give you twig, twig, magic twig I find for you. If you see my clan, clan, Sharpstick clan, tell them you saw me, I am lost. Goodbye.
om1omg52.speaker: Ormygeb

om1omg53.dialogue: Here, I give you twig, twig, magic twig I find for you. I go find my clan, clan, Sharpstick clan. Thank you. Goodbye.
om1omg53.speaker: Ormygeb

om2omr05.dialogue: Big Circle Place, orcs, orcs claw and scratch, scratch scratch to get out, out of dungeon, orcs guard the way out.
om2omr05.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr06.dialogue: Yes, these orcs are grebbo, we not crush them, grebbo strong like magic, very bad grebbo, we stay back.
om2omr06.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr08.dialogue: Oho, so you see, you are smart, you stick-legs. We are Sharpstick clan, we are strong, hulu!
om2omr08.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr09.dialogue: O no, grebbo very strong, strong like magic, orcs have grebbo, we not crush the grebbo orcs.
om2omr09.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr11.dialogue: Grebbo is, grebbo is, grebbo is a luck disease, we catch grebbo, we have no luck, never, never.
om2omr11.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr14.dialogue: Oho, you want out, you like orcs, you want out of dungeon!
om2omr14.speaker: Ormyreth

om2osf02.dialogue: Orcs inside, they want out, out out.
om2osf02.speaker: Ormserf

om2omr15.dialogue: You want out of dungeon, you must help, help Sharpstick clan, clear Sharpstick Room, yes.
om2omr15.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr18.dialogue: Down down down, yes, go down down down, look for sign, sign of Sharpstick Room.
om2omr18.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr19.dialogue: Orcs in room, Sharpstick Room. You kill grebbo orcs, we leave this place, go to Sharpstick Room.
om2omr19.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr21.dialogue: Hulu, ho, you are friend, friend to Ormyrrs, stick-legs good to Ormyrrs. You friend us, we friend you, good friend, strong friend of the earth.
om2omr21.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr22.dialogue: Kill grebbo orcs, we trade with you, many things, good things, good things trade way down in Sharpstick Room.
om2omr22.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr23.dialogue: Down down down, yes, go down down down, look for sign, sign of Sharpstick Room.
om2omr23.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr24.dialogue: Nulu, no, you stick-legs, you afraid of grebbo?
om2omr24.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr25.dialogue: Not do what we say, very bad grebbo for you.
om2omr25.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr26.dialogue: No more talk, talk no more with stick-legs. Goodbye.
om2omr26.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr28.dialogue: You no clear room, we stay here, no one go in to Circle Place.
om2omr28.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr29.dialogue: Circle Place, the way out, out of dungeon, this the old ones say.
om2omr29.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr30.dialogue: Room, big room, special to Ormyrrs, very special.
om2omr30.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr31.dialogue: But orcs there, many orcs, grebbo orcs, we not go in.
om2omr31.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr33.dialogue: Grebbo is, grebbo is, grebbo is a luck disease, we catch grebbo, we have no luck, never, never.
om2omr33.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr35.dialogue: Ola, hulu, Geb, stick-legs find Geb! Very good, you find Geb.
om2omr35.speaker: Ormyreth

om2osf03.dialogue: Hai, maybe they find Geb, lost Ormyrr, you see Geb?
om2osf03.speaker: Ormserf

om2omr38.dialogue: Maybe you help, kill grebbo orcs, clear room, clear Sharpstick Room?
om2omr38.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr39.dialogue: Hulu, goodbye, we stay, we stay here until orcs gone from room, Sharpstick Room, way down deep, goodbye.
om2omr39.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr40.dialogue: Hulu, goodbye, we go find Geb. When orcs out of room, Sharpstick Room, we will trade with you, good trades, way down deep, goodbye.
om2omr40.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr41.dialogue: Hulu, goodbye, we go find Geb. Come to room, Sharpstick Room, we will trade with you, good trades, way down deep, goodbye.
om2omr41.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr42.dialogue: Now you go in, Circle Place, see Circle Place, goodbye.
om2omr42.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr43.dialogue: Hulu, goodbye, stick-legs, we go now. Come to room, Sharpstick Room, we will trade with you, good trades, way down deep, goodbye.
om2omr43.speaker: Ormyreth

om2omr44.dialogue: No, no, no more talk-talk. Orcs stay in Sharpstick Room, we stay here. Orcs leave, we leave. Goodbye.
om2omr44.speaker: Ormyreth

om2pro00.dialogue: Praise the great strength of Ormyrrs
om2pro00.speaker: Protagonist

om2pro02.dialogue: Tell him you met a lone Ormyrr downstairs
om2pro02.speaker: Protagonist

om2pro03.dialogue: Ask him what's beyond the door they guard
om2pro03.speaker: Protagonist

om2pro04.dialogue: Ask him if you can go through the door
om2pro04.speaker: Protagonist

om2pro05.dialogue: Tell them to move away from the door
om2pro05.speaker: Protagonist

om2pro08.dialogue: Ask him about the Sharpstick Room
om2pro08.speaker: Protagonist

om2pro09.dialogue: Ask him where the Sharpstick Room is
om2pro09.speaker: Protagonist

om2pro12.dialogue: Tell him you'll clear out the Room
om2pro12.speaker: Protagonist

om2pro13.dialogue: Say you already cleared Room of orcs
om2pro13.speaker: Protagonist

om2pro14.dialogue: Refuse to clear out the Room
om2pro14.speaker: Protagonist

om2pro15.dialogue: Say maybe you'll clear out the Room
om2pro15.speaker: Protagonist

om3omk02.dialogue: Ah, the ones, these are the ones, these ones killed the Ormyrr Geb.
om3omk02.speaker: Ormyking
om3omk02.desc: spoken, admiring but with a hint of malice

om3omk03.dialogue: Ah, the ones, these are the ones, these ones killed the Sharpstick clan.
om3omk03.speaker: Ormyking
om3omk03.desc: spoken, admiring but with a hint of malice

om3omk04.dialogue: Ah, the ones, these are the ones, these ones killed the mad tribe.
om3omk04.speaker: Ormyking
om3omk04.desc: spoken, admiring but with a hint of malice

om3omk05.dialogue: Why you come, brave ones, you here why?
om3omk05.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk06.dialogue: No, you not leave, I am King of All, I say you not leave.
om3omk06.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk07.dialogue: No, no, insist you stay. This my land, I am King, you obey King.
om3omk07.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk08.dialogue: You seek treasure, maybe our treasure, eh eh?
om3omk08.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk09.dialogue: Do thing for us, easy thing, we give you treasure, plenty treasure, brave ones.
om3omk09.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk10.dialogue: I King, King of All, and King of All say, ormyrrs keep treasure.
om3omk10.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk12.dialogue: Easy thing, you find ormyrr tribe, north of here, hiding and scraping.
om3omk12.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk13.dialogue: They are mad ones, mad and evil, evil ones. You can help us, you can kill them.
om3omk13.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk14.dialogue: You brave ones, you kill ormyrrs, plenty treasure, eh?
om3omk14.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk15.dialogue: Easy thing, you find ormyrr clan, in dungeon down, hiding and scraping.
om3omk15.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk16.dialogue: They are bad ones, Sharpsticks, renegade clan. You can help us, you can kill them.
om3omk16.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk18.dialogue: Fifty gold in basket, yes, forty baskets, and pouch of gems, yes, that is plenty.
om3omk18.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk20.dialogue: Hulu, good, you find ormyrr clan, in dungeon down, hiding and scraping.
om3omk20.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk21.dialogue: They are bad ones, Sharpsticks, renegade clan. Kill them, I give you plenty treasure.
om3omk21.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk22.dialogue: Hulu, good, you find mad tribe, north of here, hiding and scraping.
om3omk22.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk23.dialogue: They are bad ones, mad ones, mad evil ones. Kill them, I give you plenty treasure.
om3omk23.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk24.dialogue: Hulu, you very brave, Cult very strong, very strong magic.
om3omk24.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk25.dialogue: Some Ormyrrs, they love Cult, you should kill those Ormyrrs.
om3omk25.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk26.dialogue: Friends of Cult very strong too, hulu! They get gifts, they learn magic, they grow strong.
om3omk26.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk27.dialogue: King of All met Mistress, got magic gift, good friend of the mighty Cult.
om3omk27.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk28.dialogue: Lizards, lizards to the west, Cult friends, yes, bow and scrape to the Mistress.
om3omk28.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk30.dialogue: Mad tribe, north of here, mad ones, mad and evil, evil ones.
om3omk30.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk31.dialogue: Outcast clan, Sharpstick clan, we cast out, they hide in dungeon, deep in dungeon, hulu.
om3omk31.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk33.dialogue: They get gifts, they learn magic, they grow strong, yes, strong and important.
om3omk33.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk35.dialogue: Oho, hai, you are lost, little lost ones, come to the King of All.
om3omk35.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk36.dialogue: I am King, yes, new King. Soon I learn magic, ormyrrs learn magic, we be strong and important, I am King of All!
om3omk36.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk37.dialogue: I ask again, why you here? Tell!
om3omk37.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk38.dialogue: Wander away again, little lost ones. Talk again to the King of All, you will die.
om3omk38.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk39.dialogue: I warn you, I am King, important King, yes. You not kill them, you talk me, you die, you understand?
om3omk39.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk40.dialogue: I tell you, you not kill them, you talk me, you die, you understand?
om3omk40.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk42.dialogue: Good! Kill them, we friends. You not kill them, you talk me, you die, you understand?
om3omk42.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk43.dialogue: You quick to say no, very quick, you not even hear what 'easy thing' is.
om3omk43.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk44.dialogue: You want to go, want to say goodbye to King of All? Then go! But do not return!
om3omk44.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk46.dialogue: Hulu, brave ones, you return, you have done as I bid you?
om3omk46.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk47.dialogue: No matter, for she speaks, speaks in my head, she says you must die.
om3omk47.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk48.dialogue: Yes, you go, you leave us now, you go join your puny gods.
om3omk48.speaker: Ormyking

om3omk50.dialogue: You return, you talk to me, you disobey the King of All.
om3omk50.speaker: Ormyking

om3pro00.speaker: Protagonist

om3pro01.speaker: Protagonist

om3pro02.speaker: Protagonist

om3pro03.speaker: Protagonist

om3pro08.speaker: Protagonist

om3pro09.dialogue: Ask him how much treasure is 'plenty'
om3pro09.speaker: Protagonist

om3pro12.dialogue: Tell him you'll think about it
om3pro12.speaker: Protagonist

om3pro13.dialogue: Ask him what he knows of 'Mistress'
om3pro13.speaker: Protagonist

om3pro14.dialogue: Ask him who the Cult 'friends' are
om3pro14.speaker: Protagonist

om3pro15.dialogue: Ask him which Ormyrrs these are
om3pro15.speaker: Protagonist

om3pro16.dialogue: Ask him why these Ormyrrs love the Cult
om3pro16.speaker: Protagonist

om3pro17.dialogue: Tell him you'll find them and kill them
om3pro17.speaker: Protagonist

om3pro19.dialogue: Tell him you'll look into it
om3pro19.speaker: Protagonist

om3pro25.dialogue: Ask what he bid you to do
om3pro25.speaker: Protagonist

om4omj02.dialogue: Ah, good, you kill the usurper King, the Ormyrrs thank you.
om4omj02.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj03.dialogue: You have dead, we are sorry, we grieve for your dead.
om4omj03.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj04.dialogue: You are hurt, we are sorry, we grieve for your hurts.
om4omj04.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj05.dialogue: Stick-legs come, Cult stick-legs come to visit.
om4omj05.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj06.dialogue: They give Pujik axe, magic axe, we ooooh! about magic axe.
om4omj06.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj07.dialogue: Pujik go crazy, slowly, slowly, Pujik mutters to Pujik in the dark.
om4omj07.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj08.dialogue: Pujik drive out chief Retha. Pujik say he King of All.
om4omj08.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj09.dialogue: Then you come! Now Pujik King of Nothing.
om4omj09.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj10.dialogue: Yes, that is good, Cult make promises, promises turn to ashes, ashes choke your heart.
om4omj10.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj11.dialogue: I am sorry, sorry, ormyrr healing not work on stick-leg people.
om4omj11.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj12.dialogue: But I have potion, it may help, I will give you potion. Later, I have other things, many things, wonderful things for trade. You come see me later.
om4omj12.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj13.dialogue: Sorry, sorry, we are poor, nothing to give, but we have things, many things, wonderful things for trade. You come later, we trade.
om4omj13.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj14.dialogue: Hulu, do you trade, will you trade with Ormyrrs?
om4omj14.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj15.dialogue: You meet me later, I have many things, dragon things, good trade for you.
om4omj15.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj16.dialogue: We trade, many creatures, we trade with many creatures all around the marsh.
om4omj16.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj17.dialogue: Grippli, yes, and nagas, yes, and sometimes dragon come.
om4omj17.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj18.dialogue: Dragon love gold, yes, we trade you things for gold.
om4omj18.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj19.dialogue: All right, we wait, we hold back good things just for you.
om4omj19.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj20.dialogue: Hulu, goodbye, come back later, stick-legs! We have things, wonderful things, good trade for you. And Flem, Flem knows legends, many legends, yes. We go now.
om4omj20.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj21.dialogue: Hulu, wait, Flem, first you talk with Flem. Flem knows of places, many places, yes.
om4omj21.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj22.dialogue: Here, here is potion. We go now, you come back, then maybe we trade? Maybe you talk with Flem? Goodbye.
om4omj22.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj23.dialogue: No, no trade now, I must go get things, wonderful things to trade.
om4omj23.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4omj24.dialogue: But here, stick-legged ones, here is Flem. Speak, Flem.
om4omj24.speaker: Ormsamaj

om4pro00.dialogue: Ask him to explain what happened
om4pro00.speaker: Protagonist

om4pro01.dialogue: Tell him you oppose the Cult
om4pro01.speaker: Protagonist

om4pro07.dialogue: Ask him where they get their goods
om4pro07.speaker: Protagonist

om4pro10.dialogue: Take the potion he offers you
om4pro10.speaker: Protagonist

om5omr02.dialogue: Hulu, stick-legs, orcs still in Sharpstick Room. We not go in, we not trade with you.
om5omr02.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr03.dialogue: Hulu, stick-legs! We have things for you, good things to trade with our friends the stick-legs.
om5omr03.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr04.dialogue: Hulu, stick-legs, soon we trade no more.
om5omr04.speaker: Ormyreth
om5omr04.desc: spoken, 'nice to see you but something's up'

om5omr05.dialogue: Hai, you tell us, you talk King, why you talk with Ormyrr King?
om5omr05.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr07.dialogue: Hai, Pujik, King, he calls himself King. He is no King!
om5omr07.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr08.dialogue: He get axe, marvelous axe, he think important, he says King...
om5omr08.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr09.dialogue: ...we say no King, he throw us out, throw Sharpsticks out of tribe.
om5omr09.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr10.dialogue: Magic-woman, red robes, she come flash! and give him axe.
om5omr10.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr11.dialogue: Room way down, down deep in dungeon, orcs in room, Sharpstick Room, grebbo orcs - very bad luck to Ormyrrs.
om5omr11.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr12.dialogue: You kill orcs, we go live in room, then we trade with you, good things to trade when we are in Sharpstick Room.
om5omr12.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr14.dialogue: Glove-things that grippli make, and swords, and bows, yes, good bows from elf.
om5omr14.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr15.dialogue: Stick-leg things, yes, things you like, we trade gold for things.
om5omr15.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr17.dialogue: We lonely, yes, heart heavy, yes, go back up to marsh, we must return to tribe.
om5omr17.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr18.dialogue: They kill us, maybe, Ormyrr King kill us, but we must go.
om5omr18.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr20.dialogue: Oi, oi, mad ormyrrs, Throttlevine clan, very bad grebbo.
om5omr20.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr21.dialogue: They want magic, try to learn magic, bad book teach them magic, they say.
om5omr21.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr22.dialogue: Book make them mad, crazy-bad, they hide, they scream, they kill everything, very bad.
om5omr22.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr23.dialogue: Book burn, I myself burn book, scatter book ashes, book no more.
om5omr23.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr25.dialogue: Hai, sad, very sad that Ormyrrs die, but no bad thing on you.
om5omr25.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr26.dialogue: Book was bad thing, magic book, bad for ormyrrs to seek magic.
om5omr26.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr28.dialogue: King! King! No King, no more, not for ormyrrs, never never.
om5omr28.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr29.dialogue: Oi! Oi! This is news, good news, very good news!
om5omr29.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr30.dialogue: You clever, yes, you strong, to kill Pujik, so-called King.
om5omr30.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr31.dialogue: Oi! Oi! We go back now, Sharpsticks! We go home.
om5omr31.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr33.dialogue: You want trade, stick-legs? You trade, good prices!
om5omr33.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr34.dialogue: Nulu, you lie, you were seen, one of us saw you talk-talk with King.
om5omr34.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr35.dialogue: Hulu, you wise, King very strong, but ormyrrs not follow King, no, only a few.
om5omr35.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr36.dialogue: What you talk about, talk so long-long with Ormyrr King?
om5omr36.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr37.dialogue: But we know you say nothing, promise nothing to King.
om5omr37.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr38.dialogue: Hulu, you wise, King very strong, but ormyrrs not like King, no, only a few.
om5omr38.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr40.dialogue: Now we tell true, heart-talk, friend to friend...
om5omr40.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr41.dialogue: ...Ormyrr King evil, he lies, do not trust Ormyrr King!
om5omr41.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr43.dialogue: Nulu, you lie, we heard, one of us heard you talk-talk with King.
om5omr43.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr44.dialogue: Speak! Speak! Or feel the points of our spears!
om5omr44.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr46.dialogue: We say speak, you tell us nothing! We should kill you! But heart say, wait.
om5omr46.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr47.dialogue: First you lie, now say nothing! We should kill you! But heart say, wait.
om5omr47.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr49.dialogue: Yes, yes, we trade, not so much good things anymore.
om5omr49.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr50.dialogue: Yes, yes, we trade, last time we trade, Ormyrrs go home.
om5omr50.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr51.dialogue: Goodbye, come back soon, we trade good things. Goodbye.
om5omr51.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr52.dialogue: Goodbye, we leave soon, go home, back to marsh. Goodbye.
om5omr52.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr53.dialogue: Goodbye, stick-legs, maybe someday we trade with you.
om5omr53.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr54.dialogue: You tell lies, too many lies, you come to kill us!
om5omr54.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr55.dialogue: Your silence speaks! It is true, you come to kill us!
om5omr55.speaker: Ormyreth

om5omr57.dialogue: Look, we tired talk-talk, no more talk-talk.
om5omr57.speaker: Ormyreth

om5pro01.dialogue: Tell them you killed Ormyrr King
om5pro01.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro02.dialogue: Ask how Ormyrr King got his magic axe
om5pro02.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro04.dialogue: Ask what they have for trade
om5pro04.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro05.dialogue: Ask them why they must stop trading
om5pro05.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro06.dialogue: Deny that you talked with the King
om5pro06.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro07.dialogue: Admit that you talked with the King
om5pro07.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro08.dialogue: Say you talked rather than fight King
om5pro08.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro09.dialogue: Ask them about mad Ormyrr tribe
om5pro09.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro10.dialogue: Tell them you killed mad Ormyrrs
om5pro10.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro13.dialogue: Say you want to trade with them now
om5pro13.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro15.dialogue: Tell truth - you talked about treasure
om5pro15.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro16.dialogue: Tell truth - you talked about the Cult
om5pro16.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro17.dialogue: Tell truth - you talked of killing Sharpsticks
om5pro17.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro18.dialogue: Tell truth - you talked of killing mad ormyrrs
om5pro18.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro19.dialogue: Lie - say you talked about the weather
om5pro19.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro20.dialogue: Lie - say you talked about trading
om5pro20.speaker: Protagonist

om5pro21.dialogue: Tell them you killed the Ormyrr King
om5pro21.speaker: Protagonist

om6omj02.dialogue: Ah, good, you kill evil king, the usurper king, the Ormyrrs thank you.
om6omj02.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj03.dialogue: Hulu, now, do you trade, will you trade with Ormyrrs?
om6omj03.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj04.dialogue: We have many things, good things, good trade for you.
om6omj04.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj05.dialogue: We trade, many creatures, we trade with many creatures in the marsh. Grippli, yes, and nagas, yes, and sometimes dragon come.
om6omj05.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj06.dialogue: Dragon love gold, yes, we trade you things for gold.
om6omj06.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj07.dialogue: All right, we wait, we hold back good things just for you. Goodbye.
om6omj07.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj08.dialogue: See, see, here are wonderful things!
om6omj08.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj09.dialogue: Ah, good, you come to me, you trade with Ormyrrs.
om6omj09.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj10.dialogue: You have gold? We have things, good things to trade for gold.
om6omj10.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj11.dialogue: Stick-legs! Stick-legs! Stick-legs come to trade.
om6omj11.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj12.dialogue: Trade, yes? More trade? Good things to trade with our stick-leg friends.
om6omj12.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6omj14.dialogue: Stick-legs! You attack Ormyrrs, friendly Ormyrrs, so I say no trade, no trade with bad stick-legs no more forever.
om6omj14.speaker: Ormsamaj

om6pro00.dialogue: ask him where they get their goods
om6pro00.speaker: Protagonist

om8omj02.dialogue: Ah, good, you kill the Cult prajah, the evil ones, the Ormyrrs thank you.
om8omj02.speaker: Ormsamaj

om8omj03.dialogue: Hulu, now, will you trade with Ormyrrs?
om8omj03.speaker: Ormsamaj

om8omj04.dialogue: We have many things, good things, good trade for you.
om8omj04.speaker: Ormsamaj

om8omj05.dialogue: We trade, many creatures, we trade with many creatures in the marsh. Grippli, yes, and nagas, yes, and sometimes dragon come.
om8omj05.speaker: Ormsamaj

om8omj06.dialogue: Dragon love gold, yes, we trade you things for gold.
om8omj06.speaker: Ormsamaj

om8omj07.dialogue: All right, we wait, we hold back good things just for you. Goodbye.
om8omj07.speaker: Ormsamaj

om8omj08.dialogue: See, come see, I have wonderful things!
om8omj08.speaker: Ormsamaj

om8omj09.dialogue: Ah, good, your victory, we hear of your victory.
om8omj09.speaker: Ormsamaj

om8omj10.dialogue: Ormyrrs all dance, the ground shaking! Ormyrrs shake ground with victory dance.
om8omj10.speaker: Ormsamaj

om8omj11.dialogue: Now we trade, yes? Good things to trade with our stick-leg friends.
om8omj11.speaker: Ormsamaj

om8pro00.dialogue: ask him where they get their goods
om8pro00.speaker: Protagonist

or1dma00.dialogue: There is no response, but you sense powerful magic waiting to be released.
or1dma00.speaker: DM

kukzuk02.dialogue: Myth Drannor! Ah, now, the n-n-n-Knights, Knights of Myth Drannor, I read a book about them.
kukzuk02.speaker: ZmLord3
kukzuk02.desc: spoken, erudite but brain-damaged and demented

kukzuk03.dialogue: And that's why they locked me up, because I know, I know, but I can't, the words, I can't words.
kukzuk03.speaker: ZmLord3
kukzuk03.desc: spoken, erudite but brain-damaged and demented

kukzuk04.dialogue: No words like nagas, I don't know no nagas, I read a book about them.
kukzuk04.speaker: ZmLord3
kukzuk04.desc: spoken, erudite but brain-damaged and demented

kukzuk05.dialogue: They serve masters, I lost my master, I read a book and she fizzled away. Oh the inhumanity.
kukzuk05.speaker: ZmLord3
kukzuk05.desc: spoken, erudite but brain-damaged and demented

kukzuk06.dialogue: That was a bad book, everything burned, burning, ashes, gone, like the fall of Myth Drannor.
kukzuk06.speaker: ZmLord3
kukzuk06.desc: spoken, erudite but brain-damaged and demented

kumzum02.dialogue: 'A note affixed to the cell door reads:  This one caught near slaughtered brothers. Probably innocent but will make a good example. Put him in the next group bound for the Pool.'
kumzum02.speaker: Prsnote1

kutdma00.dialogue: The strongbox contains a Roster of Prisoners. It lists ten prisoners, and there are notes and descriptions about each one.
kutdma00.speaker: DM

kutzut04.dialogue: 'This zombie evidently killed its master by accident - so it is insane. It has read many books, however; learn what it knows before you destroy it.'
kutzut04.speaker: PRoster

kutzut05.dialogue: 'Name: Athan. Phlanian. Known to associate with Elminster. Learn what he knows before you destroy him.'
kutzut05.speaker: PRoster

kutzut06.dialogue: 'Name: Emmeric. Phlanian. Whereabouts currently unknown; lost in transit. If found, learn what he knows before you destroy him.'
kutzut06.speaker: PRoster

kutzut07.dialogue: 'Name: Fohvrak. Probably one of the traitor Orogs. Learn what he knows before you bring him to the Pool.'
kutzut07.speaker: PRoster

kutzut08.dialogue: 'Name: unknown. One of the lizardfolk under the thrall of Malgi Hi. Learn what it knows about the sorcerer before you bring it to the Pool.'
kutzut08.speaker: PRoster

kutzut09.dialogue: 'Name: Arkhel Shaanal, Freth Drow. A Cult patrol was found slaughtered in the Catacombs, and he was nearby. Obtain a confession before you bring him to the Pool.'
kutzut09.speaker: PRoster

kutzut10.dialogue: 'Name: unknown. Found in the Catacombs - clearly a spy. Obtain a confession before you bring him to the Pool.'
kutzut10.speaker: PRoster

kutzut11.dialogue: 'Name: unknown. Drow of the House of Kilsek, who somehow escaped the Pool. Find out how, then bring him back to the Pool.'
kutzut11.speaker: PRoster

kutzut12.dialogue: 'Name: unimportant. Powerful witchdoctor, seen to kill two of our mages. Claims to want to join the Cult. Find out how he obtained his power, then bring him to the Pool.'
kutzut12.speaker: PRoster

kutzut13.dialogue: 'Name: Nathlilik. Kilsek Drow. Has rampaged up and down the Catacombs and Castle, caused much damage. Post extra guards. Watch her carefully! Learn what she knows, then bring her to the Pool.'
kutzut13.speaker: PRoster

kvnzvn02.dialogue: Aaaaaaaah! The fiend! My leg - it has taken my... uhhhhhhh....
kvnzvn02.speaker: Armathor
kvnzvn02.desc: spoken, very desperate, dying, and ghostly/spooky

kvnzvn03.dialogue: You there - you - who is there? Take the Stone, the Stone of Fate... the Well... the dwarven defense... aaaaaaaaaaaaaah!
kvnzvn03.speaker: Armathor
kvnzvn03.desc: spoken, very desperate, dying, and ghostly/spooky

kvnzvn04.dialogue: The Stone! Where is the Stone? I have failed... all is lost... Myth Drannor....
kvnzvn04.speaker: Armathor
kvnzvn04.desc: spoken, very desperate, dying, and ghostly/spooky

kuvdma05.dialogue: The ancient defenses of Castle Cormanthor come to life.
kuvdma05.speaker: DM

kuvdma06.dialogue: But they find no enemy to defend against, so they grow still once again.
kuvdma06.speaker: DM

kuidma03.dialogue: The stairs go climbing steeply up. A glimmer of sunlight filters down, along with a faint breeze wafting smells from the out-of-doors.
kuidma03.speaker: DM

xueDM00.dialogue: Here it is - the Pool of Radiance lies at your feet. It is quiet, but you immediately sense its enormous power.
xueDM00.speaker: DM

xueDM01.dialogue: It occurs to you that with this power, you could utterly destroy Kya Mordrayn and Pelendralaar.
xueDM01.speaker: DM

xueDM02.dialogue: The power of the Pool is great and ever growing. Once Kya and Pelendralaar are dust, you could continue to use the energy it channels...
xueDM02.speaker: DM

xueDM03.dialogue: ...to root out the cells and cadres of the Cult of the Dragon all over Faerun, for example, and end their evil forever.
xueDM03.speaker: DM

xueDM04.dialogue: You realize that when you gain control of the Pool, you could make Kya's lies to the Baelnorn into truth. With the Pool behind you, you could drive all the evil things out of Myth Drannor...
xueDM04.speaker: DM

xueDM05.dialogue: ...and make the city live again in glory. All Faerun would honor you!
xueDM05.speaker: DM

xueDM06.dialogue: Taking control of the Pool will be easy. Keeping control will be harder. Many in Faerun will seek to wrest its power from you...
xueDM06.speaker: DM

xueDM07.dialogue: But you realize it will be easy to fashion a trap for these fools. You can use the power of the Pool itself as bait. Mesmerized by it, your enemies will be easy prey...
xueDM07.speaker: DM

xueDM08.dialogue: You rouse yourself from your thoughts, as if from a deep slumber - to find you are not alone.
xueDM08.speaker: DM

xueDM09.dialogue: You brush aside the Pool's ensnaring spell, as a bear brushes aside cobwebs. You've escaped a cleverly laid trap!
xueDM09.speaker: DM

xuepro00.dialogue: Ponder that thought for a moment
xuepro00.speaker: Protagonist

xuepro02.dialogue: Think of other uses for the Pool's power
xuepro02.speaker: Protagonist

xuepro04.dialogue: Ponder how to control the Pool's power
xuepro04.speaker: Protagonist

kxdDM00.dialogue: With a whisper of footfalls the ghosts disappear, across the bridge that once stood here, into the warrens of Castle Cormanthor's deepest refuge.
kxdDM00.speaker: DM

kxdDM01.dialogue: But the ancient defenses failed, and the Army of Darkness invaded the refuge and collapsed its halls. Of the people who sought haven here, only the nameless ghosts remain.
kxdDM01.speaker: DM

kxcDM00.dialogue: The hundreds of ghosts are now thousands. With rising urgency they fling aside weapons and possessions, and press northward toward the illusion of safe haven.
kxcDM00.speaker: DM

kxeDM00.dialogue: You suddenly become aware of a presence. The spirit of an elf mage stands here, peering into the darkness of time.
kxeDM00.speaker: DM

kxeDM01.dialogue: She pays no notice to you or what you carry. She waits still for someone or something that may never come.
kxeDM01.speaker: DM

kxeDM02.dialogue: You become aware of a presence. The spirit of an elf mage stands here, peering into the darkness of time.
kxeDM02.speaker: DM

kxeDM03.dialogue: Suddenly she also becomes aware of you. 'The Stone!' she seems to say. 'The defenses. All is not lost.'
kxeDM03.speaker: DM

kxeDM04.dialogue: She turns and disappears to the west.
kxeDM04.speaker: DM

kxeDM05.dialogue: Again the spirit of an elf mage appears, peering into the darkness. But now she also perceives you and what you carry.
kxeDM05.speaker: DM

kxeDM06.dialogue: 'The Stone!' she says, wordlessly. 'The defenses. All is not lost.'
kxeDM06.speaker: DM

kxeDM07.dialogue: She turns and disappears to the west.
kxeDM07.speaker: DM

kxeDM08.dialogue: The ghost still stands here, intently waiting for something.
kxeDM08.speaker: DM

kxbDM00.dialogue: Suddenly you feel the presence of ghosts - hundreds of them. The shades of men, women and children flow around you like a river. Murmuring in dismay, they hurry off to the north.
kxbDM00.speaker: DM

ba9dma00.dialogue: Kya Mordrayn's passing tears a hole in the web of spells protecting the Pool of Radiance.
ba9dma00.speaker: DM

ba9dma01.dialogue: That gives Anorrweyn Evensong a moment to wield the power of the Mythal.
ba9dma01.speaker: DM

vbchac02.speaker: Hachaam
vbchac02.desc: spoken, ghostly wail, proud and satisfied, with ghost effect

vbcdma00.dialogue: One of the greatest swords created by the human wizard Demron...
vbcdma00.speaker: DM

vbcdma01.dialogue: ...with a flaming blade forged by dwarves, a hilt crafted by elven whitesmiths, and an ornate scabbard tooled by halflings...
vbcdma01.speaker: DM

vbcdma02.dialogue: ...the blade given in honor to the commander of the Wing and Horn, the city's Dragonrider cavalry, and lost now for hundreds of years - the Baneblade Morvian.
vbcdma02.speaker: DM

vbzdma00.dialogue: This gate leads back to the City Heights, if you wish to continue.
vbzdma00.speaker: DM

pl1pli02.dialogue: Listen, O listen you mortals, you who washed away the poison, listen to the song of the waters.
pl1pli02.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli03.dialogue: Listen, O listen you mortals, you who washed away the poisonous Pool, listen to the song of the waters.
pl1pli03.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli04.dialogue: My name - my name - it would take you a year to say my name, and you would say it badly, and have to say it again. Call me Plinshree.
pl1pli04.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli05.dialogue: As to what I am - why, I am the spirit of this place. A naiad, as your kind call us. My soul smiled here out of the first rainfall, and I was ancient long before the first tree grew.
pl1pli05.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli06.dialogue: But listen - listen - are you listening to the song?
pl1pli06.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli07.dialogue: No, no! Do you not hear it? The song is off. Three of the waterbells are missing.
pl1pli07.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli08.dialogue: Ahh, I am laughing, you try not to hear the water song - yet it sings inside of you! Your mortal blood, sighing in your veins, makes the same song.
pl1pli08.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli09.dialogue: But do you not hear it? The song is off. Three of the waterbells are missing.
pl1pli09.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli10.dialogue: They are shapely things, made of bone and shell, and hollowed out by sand and sea.
pl1pli10.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli11.dialogue: In the air, they are silent. But put them in the water, and they sing!
pl1pli11.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli12.dialogue: Two the serpents took, and locked away behind the Sign of Water. The last the foulers took, the dragon-lovers, after they poisoned the water.
pl1pli12.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli13.dialogue: Then give it into a city well or fountain. Return any waterbell to the water, and it will ring! I will hear it, and come to reward you.
pl1pli13.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli14.dialogue: Then give them into a city well or fountain. Return the waterbells to the water, and I will reward you.
pl1pli14.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli15.dialogue: For I have treasures to trade for them, things given to my keeping in the dark time, when Fire boiled the waters and the city died.
pl1pli15.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli16.dialogue: Yes, it is - for people of your kind. For if the song of water falters, then what waits ahead for you? Thirst and sand, floods and drowning, blood turning to dust...
pl1pli16.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli17.dialogue: But I care not what happens to you, you who are here one moment, gone the next. I care about my song, that is all, that is enough.
pl1pli17.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli18.dialogue: I want the waterbells back! I have treasures to trade for them, things given to my keeping in the dark time, when Fire boiled the waters and the city died.
pl1pli18.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli19.dialogue: If you find one of the three, give it into a city well or fountain. Return it to the water, and it will ring! I will hear it, and come to reward you.
pl1pli19.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli21.dialogue: Because silence - even a moment of it - lasts a lifetime. And music - even a year of it lasts but a moment. The waterbells make a gift of the centuries.
pl1pli21.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli22.dialogue: Oh, I do not oppose them. Why would I bother? Puny mortals, they will be dust in a moment...
pl1pli22.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli23.dialogue: ...but even if they were creatures of living flame, or tall as mountains, eventually the rain would quench their fire, and water would tumble their bones down to the Sea.
pl1pli23.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli24.dialogue: Foolish mortals! You ask for your own downfall. One glimpse, and you will join those who sail the seas, seeking, seeking...
pl1pli24.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli25.dialogue: Seeking what? To become a creature of the water once again. To drown in my beauty.
pl1pli25.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli26.dialogue: Oh, they are such things as your kind seems to delight in - slivers of metal, and eggs of glass...
pl1pli26.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli27.dialogue: Though why you treasure such bitter and tasteless things is beyond my understanding. They seem as burdens to me, not worth the smallest part of a song.
pl1pli27.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli29.dialogue: Help? I will do more than that! I will defeat them!
pl1pli29.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli30.dialogue: For even if they be creatures of living flame, or tall as mountains, rain will quench their fire in time, and water will tumble their bones down to the Sea.
pl1pli30.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli33.dialogue: But enough of this! Before I stopped to talk, I swam, yes, and I sang, so beautifully that aah! my heart aches just to remember it.
pl1pli33.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli34.dialogue: Maybe you think I waste my time, you who think 'struggle, struggle.' But think on this: What evil can stand up to the Sea?
pl1pli34.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli35.dialogue: Mark my words, if you truly oppose evil, you will learn to swim and sing. Goodbye!
pl1pli35.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli36.dialogue: Ahhh, I am laughing, you are telling the wind to leave you alone, and the rain not to fall!
pl1pli36.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli37.dialogue: Yes, it is goodbye - for you and people of your kind. For if the song of water falters, then what is ahead for you? Thirst and sand, floods and drowning, blood turning to dust...
pl1pli37.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli38.dialogue: I care nothing for your kind - here one moment, gone the next. But I want the waterbells back. Find them and return them to the waters, and I may reward you.
pl1pli38.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli39.dialogue: Otherwise, fear death by water! For evil and good, the mighty and the low - all you mortals are the same, once you enter the whirlpool.
pl1pli39.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli40.dialogue: Listen, now: in your travels you may find a waterbell, worthless to you maybe, if beauty counts for nothing.
pl1pli40.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli41.dialogue: Do not cast it aside! Give the waterbell unto the water, drop it into one of the city's wells! And maybe we will talk again about the music of the waters.
pl1pli41.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli42.dialogue: Then will I swim, yes, swim even more beautifully than before. I will swim so that the rocks weep and dissolve, and sing the songs that wash the hills and valleys, and make them be born anew.
pl1pli42.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli43.dialogue: This I do no matter what you do or say, but now you are a part of it, and this is noble beyond imagining for those of your kind. Goodbye.
pl1pli43.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli44.dialogue: And you can be part of this - just give the waterbell back to the water. Goodbye.
pl1pli44.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli45.dialogue: And you can be part of this - just give the waterbells back to the water. Goodbye.
pl1pli45.speaker: plinshre

pl1pli46.dialogue: Remember! Give the waterbells back to the water! Goodbye.
pl1pli46.speaker: plinshre

pl1pro01.dialogue: Ask who and what she is
pl1pro01.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro02.dialogue: Close your ears against the song
pl1pro02.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro03.dialogue: Tell her to leave you alone
pl1pro03.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro06.dialogue: Tell her you found a waterbell
pl1pro06.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro07.dialogue: Tell her you found her waterbells
pl1pro07.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro10.dialogue: Ask her why she needs the waterbells
pl1pro10.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro11.dialogue: Ask her about the treasures she has
pl1pro11.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro13.dialogue: Tell her you also oppose the 'dragon-lovers'
pl1pro13.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro14.dialogue: Ask her to help in your war with the Cult
pl1pro14.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro15.dialogue: Tell her you will try to find her waterbells
pl1pro15.speaker: Protagonist

pl1pro16.dialogue: Tell her you will give her the waterbells
pl1pro16.speaker: Protagonist

pl2pli03.dialogue: O mortals, you who washed away the poisonous Pool of Radiance...
pl2pli03.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli04.dialogue: ...now try to win a victory more lasting! Restore the Splashing Song. Find the waterbells. Give them back to the water!
pl2pli04.speaker: plinshre
pl2pli04.desc: spoken, endlessly humored by the foolish pride of mortals

pl2pli05.dialogue: For even now evil creeps into the places you thought were clean. But the Song, ah, the Song of Water runs on and on and on.
pl2pli05.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli06.dialogue: Oyaa, the Pool is gone, the poisonous Pool, dissolved and washed away!
pl2pli06.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli07.dialogue: And they who stole the Waterbells, you have pitched them into the whirlpool, oyaa!
pl2pli07.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli08.dialogue: They will return - evil always returns. But always will heroes and deep water await them. And when they hear the Splashing Song, they will know their doom.
pl2pli08.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli09.dialogue: Oh! And I have been to the deepest places, and found another thing that may be of use to your kind. Farewell!
pl2pli09.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli13.dialogue: O mortals, you who washed away the poisonous Pool of Radiance...
pl2pli13.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli14.dialogue: ...dwell not overlong on your brief victory. Evil dies, but it is never dead. Even now, behind your back, the shadows grow long.
pl2pli14.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli15.dialogue: Do you desire an achievement that will last down the centuries? Then restore the Splashing Song. Give the waterbells back to the water!
pl2pli15.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli16.dialogue: Ahhh! This is E'lenthe, whom the waves carved from whalebone. Ah! I dance to have her back! Already it is if she had never been silent.
pl2pli16.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli17.dialogue: Oyaa! You have found Shihuala! Listen!
pl2pli17.speaker: plinshre
pl2pli17.desc: spoken, delight and amazement -oyaa! is a shout of joy, sfx of beautiful bell tone

pl2pli18.dialogue: This is the note that brings sun from rain, that makes pools glow with light and turns air crisp with joy.
pl2pli18.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli19.dialogue: This is best of all, Jawhimishan - the Waterbell of Endless Music. O Jawhimishan, how I have missed you!
pl2pli19.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli20.dialogue: In exchange, I have a gift for you. Have you found any of the other waterbells?
pl2pli20.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli21.dialogue: Here - I have for you another treasure, brought up from the deeps. Did you find the last missing waterbell? O that would be a marvel!
pl2pli21.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli23.dialogue: Ah, when last we met, you barely escaped the deep water...
pl2pli23.speaker: plinshre
pl2pli23.desc: spoken, warning you made her angry when you last spoke

pl2pli24.dialogue: But now you have brought me a waterbell! And see, my anger has ebbed - and in its place, a gift!
pl2pli24.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli26.dialogue: Aaah, I am laughing, you mortals are in such a hurry!
pl2pli26.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli27.dialogue: For certainly the waterbell would have come back to me in time.
pl2pli27.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli28.dialogue: But yet, I am happy to have it - and to get rid of this, which has no value to me.
pl2pli28.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli30.dialogue: You have made good your promise - and I have not forgotten mine!
pl2pli30.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli32.dialogue: You have made me happy. So here, I give you something you mortals seem to delight in...
pl2pli32.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli33.dialogue: You have given back to the water one of its treasures...
pl2pli33.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli34.dialogue: And see! I have brought you one of the treasures given to me, a long blade of purest crystal...
pl2pli34.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli35.dialogue: Or no, I have it not. Oh well, no matter. Here is a shiny thing that may be useful to your kind.
pl2pli35.speaker: plinshre
pl2pli35.desc: spoken, flighty 'oops I guess I don't really have that, nevermind!'

pl2pli36.dialogue: You have restored the music to the waters, O mortals. I will swim ever more beautifully, and you will swim with me.
pl2pli36.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli37.dialogue: It is one of the things given into my care in the time of Fire, the dark time when the city died.
pl2pli37.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli38.dialogue: I have many such things to be rid of, if you should find more waterbells.
pl2pli38.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli39.dialogue: I know of what you speak, but I do not know, for I do not care, it matters none to me. But for your sake I will try to remember...
pl2pli39.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli40.dialogue: Down it goes, I think, from under the spires, and its tendrils touch the deep waters.
pl2pli40.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli41.dialogue: But the waters care not. Evil always plants the seeds for its own downfall. Each evil deed spawns a hero. The waters wait - we are good at waiting.
pl2pli41.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli42.dialogue: But I must swim, and you must struggle on, in the way of your kind. Here is a thing that may aid you - but first...
pl2pli42.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli43.dialogue: Receive this rare blessing: the waters of knowledge, shaken from a naiad's hand.
pl2pli43.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli45.dialogue: Yes - I must swim, and you must struggle on in the way of your kind. Here is a thing that may aid you - but first...
pl2pli45.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli48.dialogue: Aah, you are mortals. For a moment, I had forgotten.
pl2pli48.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli49.dialogue: Aah, but you are mortals! For a moment, I had forgotten.
pl2pli49.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli50.dialogue: Mortals - and yet a little more. For the water sings, and you are part of it now. What the water knows, you know - a little bit.
pl2pli50.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli51.dialogue: Now - I must swim, and you must struggle on in the way of your kind. Here is a thing that may aid you - but first...
pl2pli51.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli52.dialogue: Ah, spoken like the mortals you are. For a moment, I had forgotten.
pl2pli52.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli53.dialogue: You turn a blind eye to beauty, and grasp for things of death.
pl2pli53.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli54.dialogue: Very well, I have a reward for you. A woman gave this to me in the dark time, just before the flame engulfed her and her children...
pl2pli54.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli55.dialogue: Why did she not entrust herself and her children to the waters? I would have been grateful for the gift - and more merciful than the flames...
pl2pli55.speaker: plinshre

pl2pli56.dialogue: But no, she only gave me this. And now I give it to you.
pl2pli56.speaker: plinshre

pl2pro00.dialogue: Tell her you can't swim all that well
pl2pro00.speaker: Protagonist

pl2pro02.dialogue: Agree to swim with the naiad
pl2pro02.speaker: Protagonist

pl2pro03.dialogue: Ask her where the Pool of Radiance is
pl2pro03.speaker: Protagonist

popdmaYA.dialogue: Far away, you hear the sound of distant magic coming to life!
popdmaYA.speaker: DM

pordmaYA.dialogue: Tapping sounds are coming from the mouth of the Great Stone Head.
pordmaYA.speaker: DM

pordmaYB.dialogue: It sounds like a ringsmith is at work.
pordmaYB.speaker: DM

kybDMYA.dialogue: The moment you free the mysterious stone from its metal bonds, it rockets up out of sight, and sails off in the direction of the City Heights.
kybDMYA.speaker: DM

kybDMYB.dialogue: This stone also flies away, toward the City Heights.
kybDMYB.speaker: DM

kybDMYC.dialogue: Freed from its metal bonds, the Orrery Planet sails back to the Orrery - just as Harldain Ironbar told you it would.
kybDMYC.speaker: DM

kybDMYD.dialogue: Freed from its metal bonds, the Orrery Planet sails back to the Orrery - just as Harldain Ironbar told you it would.
kybDMYD.speaker: DM

pr1dmaYA.dialogue: The room beyond the barred window seems unnaturally dark. Out of the blackness, a voice speaks to you.
pr1dmaYA.speaker: DM

pr1pre02.dialogue: Who's there? What do you want? -Beware, I warn you, I am not defenseless!
pr1pre02.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre03.dialogue: Goodbye. But say, in your travels, if you ever come upon any neckpieces - necklaces, amulets, torcs, chokers, collars and so on - show them to me.
pr1pre03.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre04.dialogue: I am a collector, you might say, of such things. Now, farewell.
pr1pre04.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre05.dialogue: Ah, you have good in your hearts, not evil! I have seen adventurers like you before. Human, or something like it.
pr1pre05.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre06.dialogue: No, even I can see you are not defenseless. Human, aren't you? Or something like it?
pr1pre06.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre07.dialogue: I like humans - most of them, anyway.
pr1pre07.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre08.dialogue: Ah, you have good in your hearts, not evil! I am relieved to know this - I have seen adventurers like you before.
pr1pre08.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre09.dialogue: Good ones. Very, very good ones.
pr1pre09.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre10.dialogue: Prisoner? Oh yes, indeed I am, prisoner of my desires...
pr1pre10.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre11.dialogue: Good travels to you. But say, before you go, do you have any fine neckpieces? Necklaces, amulets, torcs, chokers, neck rings, pendants, collars, of very high quality?
pr1pre11.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre12.dialogue: I am a collector, you might say, of just about anything that goes on one's neck.
pr1pre12.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre14.dialogue: Strange - at least one of you seems to be wearing one. A very nice one, too. Goodbye.
pr1pre14.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre15.dialogue: Ah, maybe when you get to know me better - and I get to know you - that will be revealed. Until then - goodbye.
pr1pre15.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre16.dialogue: I am Preybelish. Don't ask me to talk about myself - it's a sad story - my name is all you need to know.
pr1pre16.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre17.dialogue: My door has the Glyph of Gobtadan emblazoned on the floor before it - as evil a sign as you will find - and the door will stay shut until the Word of Venom is uttered aloud.
pr1pre17.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre18.dialogue: I sit in the darkness and contemplate my mistakes - and every once in a while I receive a glimmer of joy from travelers such as you.
pr1pre18.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre19.dialogue: Oh, I've done things - terrible things! But I don't want to talk about myself.
pr1pre19.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre20.dialogue: I dare not tell you the name - but he is a pinnacle of evil, believe me! But I don't want to talk about my problems.
pr1pre20.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre21.dialogue: Well, everybody needs to oppose somebody - except for me. But I don't want to talk about myself.
pr1pre21.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre22.dialogue: Oh, you don't want to do that. You don't want to get tangled up with me.
pr1pre22.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre24.dialogue: Let's talk about you. You don't have any necklaces, do you? Any of you? Pity.
pr1pre24.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre25.dialogue: Let's talk about you. You're not wearing a necklace, are you? Any of you? Pity.
pr1pre25.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre26.dialogue: Oh, I don't mean common trinkets like amulets of protection. I mean rare and wonderful neckpieces, like the Collar of Nefridina or Cegilune's Blessed Necklace.
pr1pre26.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre27.dialogue: I am a collector of such things, you see. But now, tell me more of yourselves.
pr1pre27.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre28.dialogue: Goodbye. If you find any fine necklaces out there, think of me!
pr1pre28.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre29.dialogue: Never been there myself. It has been nice talking with you...
pr1pre29.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre30.dialogue: If you find any fine necklaces out there, think of me!
pr1pre30.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre31.dialogue: In Myth Drannor? Unlikely place for anyone to raise one of those.
pr1pre31.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre32.dialogue: Maybe you should seek out rare treasures instead. Many of the old ones are still around.
pr1pre32.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre33.dialogue: And if you find any fine necklaces out there, think of me! Goodbye.
pr1pre33.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre34.dialogue: Ah, I quite agree with you there. The Cult of the Dragon helps nobody but itself.
pr1pre34.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre35.dialogue: Still, you have to admire how much power they've scraped together. Very powerful, the Cult. Very, very powerful.
pr1pre35.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre36.dialogue: Maybe you should seek out rare treasures instead. Much less dangerous, and more profitable too, or so I hear.
pr1pre36.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre37.dialogue: Ah, I quite agree with you there. They help nobody but themselves.
pr1pre37.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre38.dialogue: Still, you have to admire how much power they've scraped together. Very powerful, those mages are. Very, very powerful.
pr1pre38.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre39.dialogue: Maybe you should seek out rare treasures instead. Much less dangerous, and more profitable too, or so I hear.
pr1pre39.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre40.dialogue: I want to talk about you now. And that marvelous neckpiece I see you wearing. What is it, may I ask? And do you have any others?
pr1pre40.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre41.dialogue: Do you now? Then tell me about one or two of them.
pr1pre41.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre43.dialogue: I am a collector of neckpieces. They fascinate me.
pr1pre43.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre44.dialogue: I don't mean common trinkets like amulets of protection. I mean rare and wonderful neckpieces, like the Collar of Nefridina or Cegilune's Blessed Necklace.
pr1pre44.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre45.dialogue: So tell me about the necklaces you own. I am dying to hear about them!
pr1pre45.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre46.dialogue: Well, now you know. And I am curious too, about the necklaces you own.
pr1pre46.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre47.dialogue: Yes, I thought that's what it was. Nothing else has its color, its vibrancy!
pr1pre47.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre48.dialogue: Yes, that explains it. Quite a rare treasure, is Theodore's Token of Luck!
pr1pre48.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre49.dialogue: I - I am amazed. I had heard tales but - I didn't think they were true! Tyr's Locket of Justice... very effective against the plentiful undead!
pr1pre49.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre50.dialogue: Onglore's Amulet of War, you say. Well, that is rare and wonderful.
pr1pre50.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre51.dialogue: Well, that is a rare and wonderful neckpiece!
pr1pre51.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre52.dialogue: Not as rare as the masterpieces in my collection, of course, but still...
pr1pre52.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre53.dialogue: It's too bad I'm, ah, indisposed at the moment. Come and see me later - I may be able to persuade you to let go of it.
pr1pre53.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre54.dialogue: Oh yes, you must come by later. Until then, goodbye!
pr1pre54.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre55.dialogue: Maybe we can discuss your neckpieces some other time. Goodbye.
pr1pre55.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre57.dialogue: Ah, but those are common trinkets, barely worth a glance. I was hoping you'd have a truly wonderful neckpiece, like the Torc of Torm.
pr1pre57.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre58.dialogue: If you find something like that, come and see me. Until then, goodbye.
pr1pre58.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre59.dialogue: Quite all right. I understand. You are probably quite attached to them.
pr1pre59.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre60.dialogue: And won't let them go without a fight.
pr1pre60.speaker: preybeli

pr1dma00.dialogue: Haashingutak, the Word of Venom, opens the sealed door!
pr1dma00.speaker: dm

pr1pre62.dialogue: Aaaah - but you see - I can't let a neckpiece like that simply walk away...
pr1pre62.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre64.dialogue: You have the Starstone?! Not for long.
pr1pre64.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre65.dialogue: Ah, wait, I can guess. I sensed it when you approached. You have its Starstone, although the mighty Gobtadan alone can explain how you came by it...
pr1pre65.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre66.dialogue: No matter. It will not be yours much longer.
pr1pre66.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre67.dialogue: And I simply must have it.
pr1pre67.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre69.dialogue: The Wizard's Torc? Why, yes, I own it. Of course I own it. Why do you ask?
pr1pre69.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre77.dialogue: What did I tell you when we met? I collect fine neckpieces. Yet did you bring me any? Do I see any adorning your bony necks? No.
pr1pre77.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre78.dialogue: It's enough to send a body deep into dark despair - or off into a spitting rage.
pr1pre78.speaker: preybeli
pr1pre78.desc: spoken, hurt and then with malice

pr1pre80.dialogue: No offense, but the neckpieces you have are very common. What I seek are the rare pieces - personal masterworks such as Athraxi's Amulet or the Gorget of Purgelum.
pr1pre80.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre81.dialogue: No offense, but the neckpiece you have is very common. What I seek are the rare pieces - personal masterworks such as Athraxi's Amulet or the Gorget of Purgelum.
pr1pre81.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre82.dialogue: I can see out, but you can't see in. That's the beauty of the spell.
pr1pre82.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre83.dialogue: I cast it because, when you see someone, you learn a lot about them. Take you for instance. I can see you're human-shaped, and are probably adventurers of some kind.
pr1pre83.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre84.dialogue: But what you can't learn by seeing is whether or not someone is trustworthy. If they will help you - or plunder your fortune - when you are down on your luck.
pr1pre84.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre85.dialogue: Which is what you really want to know, isn't it? If someone can be trusted. Or not.
pr1pre85.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre87.dialogue: Trusted to live and let live? Usually.
pr1pre87.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre88.dialogue: Trusted to not be a fool? Maybe.
pr1pre88.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre89.dialogue: Trusted to see a fine necklace and not desire it of all things? Never.
pr1pre89.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre90.dialogue: Oh, I have necklaces, and amulets, and lockets, and torcs, and collars, and gorgets, and even a neck ring and some chokers. All of exquisite beauty!
pr1pre90.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre91.dialogue: Ah, they would shock and amaze you! I enjoy putting them all on. Such a sight! But as for what they are exactly, we are not friends enough for me to say.
pr1pre91.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre92.dialogue: What must I do to persuade you to part with it?
pr1pre92.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre93.dialogue: Well, now you've really tickled my fangs. What could it be?
pr1pre93.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre94.dialogue: I'm too curious to continue asking politely.
pr1pre94.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre95.dialogue: Dare I tell you? Oh, very well. You know about nagas, don't you? Serpentine creatures, very wise and powerful, but also very fierce-looking?
pr1pre95.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre96.dialogue: Not all nagas are evil. Some are peace-loving and loyal to those who are friendly to them.
pr1pre96.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre97.dialogue: Fortunately, I do not have that problem.
pr1pre97.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre98.dialogue: Ah! Tell me about it. Show it to me!
pr1pre98.speaker: preybeli

pr1pre99.dialogue: Where is it? What have you done? Aaaagh, you imbeciles, I should just kill you all now!
pr1pre99.speaker: preybeli
pr1pre99.desc: spoken, outburst in shock and horror

pr1prea2.dialogue: The necklace! That fabulous neckpiece! You're not wearing it, any of you! You pawned it for some trifle, or fumbled it into some abyss!
pr1prea2.speaker: preybeli

pr1prea3.dialogue: If it is lost to me, I will kill you all slowly, one by one!
pr1prea3.speaker: preybeli

pr1prea4.dialogue: You will barely live long enough to regret your mistake!
pr1prea4.speaker: preybeli

pr1prea5.dialogue: Ah - you're right - I am overwrought.
pr1prea5.speaker: preybeli

pr1prea6.dialogue: You have the neckpiece in a pocket somewhere, that's it. Safe in a pocket, that's right, isn't it?
pr1prea6.speaker: preybeli

pr1prea7.dialogue: No, no, I can see it in your faces - you don't have it! You pawned it for some trifle, or fumbled it into an abyss!
pr1prea7.speaker: preybeli

pr1prea8.dialogue: Ah! Excellent!  And now you must give Kluusar's Bloodstone Amulet to me.
pr1prea8.speaker: preybeli

pr1prea9.dialogue: Ah! Excellent! And now you must give Theodore's Token of Luck to me.
pr1prea9.speaker: preybeli

pr1preb0.dialogue: Ah! Excellent! And now you must give Tyr's Locket of Justice to me.
pr1preb0.speaker: preybeli

pr1preb1.dialogue: Ah! Excellent! And now you must give Onglore's Amulet of War to me.
pr1preb1.speaker: preybeli

pr1preb3.dialogue: Ah - ah - ah - it's you, the do-gooders, come to talk to me again. To ease my loneliness.
pr1preb3.speaker: preybeli

pr1preb4.dialogue: You remember me, don't you? Preybelish? The voice out of the darkness - the collector of neckpieces.
pr1preb4.speaker: preybeli

pr1preb5.dialogue: But looking at what you've got around your necks - it seems you've disappointed me. No truly fine neckpieces.
pr1preb5.speaker: preybeli

pr1preb6.dialogue: The Wizard's Torc? Why, yes, I own it. Of course I own it. Why do you ask?
pr1preb6.speaker: preybeli

pr1preb8.dialogue: Ah, I see you still have Kluusar's Bloodstone Amulet! Since you mentioned it, I have thought of nothing else.
pr1preb8.speaker: preybeli

pr1preb9.dialogue: Ah, I see you still have Theodore's Token of Luck! Since you mentioned it, I have thought of nothing else.
pr1preb9.speaker: preybeli

pr1prec2.speaker: preybeli

pr1pred9.dialogue: Ah, what do I see here? One of you is wearing Theodore's Token of Luck!
pr1pred9.speaker: preybeli

pr1pree0.dialogue: Ah, what do I see here? One of you is wearing Tyr's Locket of Justice!
pr1pree0.speaker: preybeli

pr1pree1.dialogue: Ah, what do I see here? One of you is wearing Onglore's Amulet of War!
pr1pree1.speaker: preybeli

pr1pree2.dialogue: Ah, I am disappointed of course. Even a little bit angry! I still want that neckpiece! What do you suggest?
pr1pree2.speaker: preybeli

pr1pree3.dialogue: For free? That is a mighty gift! Are you sure?
pr1pree3.speaker: preybeli

pr1dma01.dialogue: You toss Kluusar's Bloodstone Amulet through the window. It is swallowed up by the blackness beyond.
pr1dma01.speaker: DM

pr1dma02.dialogue: You toss Theodore's Token of Luck through the window. It is swallowed up by the blackness beyond.
pr1dma02.speaker: DM

pr1dma03.dialogue: You toss Tyr's Locket of Justice through the window. It is swallowed up by the blackness beyond.
pr1dma03.speaker: DM

pr1dma04.dialogue: You toss Onglore's Amulet of War through the window. It is swallowed up by the blackness beyond.
pr1dma04.speaker: DM

pr1pree8.dialogue: Thank you for your generous gift. I realize that you expect me to give you something in return - if not now, maybe later.
pr1pree8.speaker: preybeli

pr1pree9.dialogue: Fortunately, that's not the kind of creature I am.
pr1pree9.speaker: preybeli

pr1pref0.dialogue: Now I must admire this wonderful neckpiece for a while. It really is magnificent! Goodbye.
pr1pref0.speaker: preybeli

pr1pref1.dialogue: Trade? Ah, but I am afraid I couldn't bear to part with anything in my collection. No, I'm afraid a trade is out of the question... unless...
pr1pref1.speaker: preybeli

pr1pref2.dialogue: ...you give me the necklace, and I give you the sweet kiss of oblivion.
pr1pref2.speaker: preybeli

pr1pref3.dialogue: Ah. I was afraid of that. I am disappointed of course - even a little bit angry!
pr1pref3.speaker: preybeli

pr1pref5.dialogue: You know how much I crave the neckpiece! And yet you deny me of it. You hold it out - you flaunt it - then snatch it away! Doesn't that seem cruel to you? Heartless?
pr1pref5.speaker: preybeli

pr1pref6.dialogue: But - you know how much I crave the neckpiece! And yet you deny me of it. You hold it out - you flaunt it - then snatch it away! Doesn't that seem cruel to you? Heartless?
pr1pref6.speaker: preybeli

pr1pref7.dialogue: The more I think about it, the more I think someone needs to teach you a lesson.
pr1pref7.speaker: preybeli

pr1pref8.dialogue: Very well. I'll bide my time. What would you like to talk about? Are you looking for something, maybe?
pr1pref8.speaker: preybeli

pr1pref9.dialogue: Rings! What use have I for rings? Rings and swords and wands, I pitch them down the nearest crack.
pr1pref9.speaker: preybeli

pr1preg0.dialogue: So you seek Oblivion, do you? Ah me, that is funny.
pr1preg0.speaker: preybeli

pr1preg1.dialogue: Because I want nothing more than to give it to you.
pr1preg1.speaker: preybeli

pr1preg2.dialogue: Ah, that is up from here, way up, near the surface.
pr1preg2.speaker: preybeli

pr1preg3.dialogue: I hear there may be a fine necklace up there as well. If you find it, bring it back to show me, will you?
pr1preg3.speaker: preybeli

pr1preg4.dialogue: Ah, you are kind, you are my friends, to bring me neckpieces like this. I will try to be patient, until you return. Goodbye.
pr1preg4.speaker: preybeli

pr1preg6.dialogue: That old thing? It is not here. It was taken into the Catacombs long ago, and no one gets into the Catacombs these days.
pr1preg6.speaker: preybeli

pr1preg7.dialogue: Take my advice, forget that old bone. There's still plenty of treasure right here in the dungeons. Necklaces, for example. Plenty of necklaces still to be found.
pr1preg7.speaker: preybeli

pr1preg8.dialogue: And if you do find any, you will show them to me, won't you? I will try to be patient until you return. Goodbye.
pr1preg8.speaker: preybeli

pr1preh1.dialogue: Well then, at last my Wizard's Torc can be made complete!
pr1preh1.speaker: preybeli

pr1preh3.dialogue: Well, we have that in common.
pr1preh3.speaker: preybeli

pr1preh4.dialogue: Take my advice - there's plenty of useful treasure right here in the dungeons. Necklaces, for example. Plenty of necklaces still to be found.
pr1preh4.speaker: preybeli

pr1preh6.dialogue: Ah, no, my frail two-legged friends, don't do that! You'll be killed, and that marvelous neckpiece will be lost to me forever!
pr1preh6.speaker: preybeli

pr1preh7.dialogue: No, no, no, I cannot allow that to happen...
pr1preh7.speaker: preybeli

pr1preh9.dialogue: Ah, the Glyph of Gobtadan, very powerful, very evil! Until it is unwritten by the Word of Venom, no living being will pass my door.
pr1preh9.speaker: preybeli

pr1prei0.dialogue: You're leaving? Good travels to you. And if you find any fine neckpieces -  necklaces, amulets, torcs, chokers, neck rings, gorgets, pendants, collars - think of me.
pr1prei0.speaker: preybeli

pr1prei1.dialogue: Goodbye. Show me a new neckpiece, next time you come!
pr1prei1.speaker: preybeli

pr1preYB.dialogue: Very well then.  I'll bide my time. Goodbye - show me a new neckpiece, next time you come!
pr1preYB.speaker: preybeli

pr1prei4.dialogue: Your neckwear does not impress me. Next time, show me something new.
pr1prei4.speaker: preybeli

pr1prei5.dialogue: I'm bored with Kluusar's Bloodstone Amulet. Bring me something else, and I might let you have it back.
pr1prei5.speaker: preybeli

pr1prei6.dialogue: I'm bored with Theodore's Token of Luck. Bring me something else, and I might let you have it back.
pr1prei6.speaker: preybeli

pr1prei7.dialogue: I'm bored with Tyr's Locket of Justice. Bring me something else, and I might let you have it back.
pr1prei7.speaker: preybeli

pr1prei8.dialogue: I'm bored with Onglore's Amulet of War you gave me. Bring me something else, and I might let you have it back.
pr1prei8.speaker: preybeli

pr1prej1.dialogue: Ah - I can see it in your faces - you've come to offer me a rare neckpiece.
pr1prej1.speaker: preybeli

pr1prej2.dialogue: Ah - I can see it in your faces - you've found a neckpiece for me.
pr1prej2.speaker: preybeli

pr1prej4.dialogue: Ah, that is marvelous. Marvelous! I simply must have them, all of them, right now.
pr1prej4.speaker: preybeli

pr1prej5.dialogue: No, no, we must talk about your neckpiece - I hope to own it, you see. Won't you tell me something about it?
pr1prej5.speaker: preybeli

pr1prej6.dialogue: No, no, you must stay, we must talk about your rare neckpiece - I hope to own it, you see. Won't you tell me something about it?
pr1prej6.speaker: preybeli

pr1prej7.dialogue: Ah, that is marvelous. Marvelous! I simply must have it, right now.
pr1prej7.speaker: preybeli

pr1prej8.dialogue: Ah, that is marvelous. Marvelous! I simply must have them, all of them, right now.
pr1prej8.speaker: preybeli

pr1prej9.dialogue: Ah, I know what you're thinking - 'this necklace will lure the old lizard out of his hidey-hole, and then we can kill him.'
pr1prej9.speaker: preybeli

pr1prek0.dialogue: You think I'm not really a helpless prisoner, that I know the Word of Venom, and can open my door at any time.
pr1prek0.speaker: preybeli

pr1prek1.dialogue: Well, if that's what you're thinking, you're right.
pr1prek1.speaker: preybeli

pr1dma05.dialogue: Haashingutak, the Word of Venom, opens the sealed door!
pr1dma05.speaker: dm

pr1prek3.dialogue: Wait! I will not stop you from leaving. But I assure you that if you return, all you will find is stony silence and the powerful Glyph of Gobtadan guarding my door.
pr1prek3.speaker: preybeli

pr1prek4.dialogue: You have Kluusar's Bloodstone Amulet. Give it to me!
pr1prek4.speaker: preybeli

pr1prek5.dialogue: You have Theodore's Token of Luck. Give it to me!
pr1prek5.speaker: preybeli

pr1prek6.dialogue: You have Tyr's Locket of Justice. Give it to me!
pr1prek6.speaker: preybeli

pr1prek7.dialogue: You have Onglore's Amulet of War. Give it to me!
pr1prek7.speaker: preybeli

pr1prek8.dialogue: Your offer is heartfelt, and genuine, and very very attractive...
pr1prek8.speaker: preybeli

pr1prek9.dialogue: ...but I will decline it. Come in and get me, if you dare. I will bandy words with you no more.
pr1prek9.speaker: preybeli

pr1prel0.dialogue: That is not true. All your neckpieces will be mine, and your necks with them!
pr1prel0.speaker: preybeli

pr1prel1.dialogue: I believe this is farewell forever. Enjoy your loss.
pr1prel1.speaker: preybeli

pr1prel2.dialogue: Ah, I think you will find that all who knew the Word are dead. Very, very dead.
pr1prel2.speaker: preybeli

pr1prel4.dialogue: I will not stop you from leaving. Just be warned - if you return, all you will find is stony silence and the powerful Glyph of Gobtadan guarding my door.
pr1prel4.speaker: preybeli

pwcdmaYA.speaker: DM

pwcdmaYB.dialogue: The sound of it briefly chokes shut every throat in the room.
pwcdmaYB.speaker: DM

pwddmaYA.dialogue: The hide contains the Word of Dragon, but you have already learned it.

pwzdma00.speaker: dm

pwvdma00.speaker: dm

qlgdmaYA.speaker: DM

qlgdmaYB.dialogue: He helped you to gain healing and wisdom from elves sheltering in the Stillwater ruins.

qlgdmaYC.dialogue: They enabled you to unseal the way into the dwarven Dungeons of Myth Drannor.
qlgdmaYC.speaker: DM

qlgdmaYD.dialogue: You defeated the orc chieftain Zud.

qlgdmaYO.dialogue: You returned the Ruby of Earthborn Wind to its proper place, and restored the Channels of Earthborn Wind.

qlgdmaYP.dialogue: You found the Waters of Life in a well guarded by lizardfolk.
qlgdmaYP.speaker: DM

qlgdmaYU.dialogue: You freed the Rhonglyn from Borea's icy grip, and used the ancient device to reach the Speculum.

qlgdmaYW.dialogue: You found and freed the ancient Ring of Calling from the Skeletal Arm.
